method: Immutable first observed pregame quote plus near-start NFL checkpoints; NFL line calibration uses the latest eligible snapshot per contract. Settled contract outcomes, or final ESPN score for half-point totals when settlement is missing; no postgame forecast backfill. Lower Brier/log loss is better. Market-only rows are identical by design. Gross positive-EV return excludes fees and is not a placed-bet ledger.

nflTotalStudy.note: All variants and feature timestamps were archived before kickoff. One latest standard Over threshold represents each game for MAE; ALT and opposite-side contracts are correlated, so their Brier counts are descriptive. A review flag requires at least 50 games across four unseen weeks, lower MAE in at least 75% of weeks, and better standard Over and Under Brier scores. No candidate automatically changes live selections.
